name: Larvotto Resources Limited
summary: Larvotto Resources Limited, a Nedlands company established in 2020, acquires, explores and advances mineral assets in Australia and New Zealand, targeting copper, gold, cobalt, nickel, lithium and platinum group elements. In Australia it wholly owns the Mt Isa Copper project of about 900 square kilometers in Queensland and the Eyre project of about 580 square kilometers near Kalgoorlie.
